2010年作成のDefense Intelligence Reference Document「非中性子融合推進」は、米国防情報局（DIA）Technology Warning Divisionが作成した参照報告書で、非中性子（aneutronic）核融合を宇宙・近宇宙推進へ適用するための基礎と展望を概説する。本文は融合プラズマ物理の基本、主要な閉じ込め方式（磁気閉じ込め：磁気ミラー、トカマク、ステラレータ、スフェロマク等；慣性閉じ込め；静電（IEC）閉じ込め：Fusor/Polywell；磁気―慣性閉じ込め；高密度プラズマフォーカス（DPF）；反転磁場配置）を解説し、典型的な非中性子反応例（例：D+3He、p+7Li、p+11B）とそれらが示す高い着火温度やローソン基準との関係を示す。報告は、非中性子燃料が高速中性子の発生と遮蔽・材料劣化問題を回避できる利点を説明し、こうした概念を推進系（融合炉設計、空気取り入れ型・イオン・プラズマスラスタ等）に適用した場合、従来の電気推進器より高性能を示し得るとする。今後の開発は大型GEO衛星の需要が当面の動機になり得るが、火星等へ向かう100 kW超の高出力推進には閉じ込め、パルス電源、イオンビーム加速等の主要技術で大幅な進展が必要であると結論付ける。報告書は章立てで応用領域、最近の米国・国際・NASA・民間の取り組み、今後のロードマップを整理し多数の図表で比較・評価している。
The 2010 Defense Intelligence Reference Document "Aneutronic Fusion Propulsion," prepared by the DIA Technology Warning Division, is a reference review of applying aneutronic fusion to space and near-space propulsion. It summarizes basic fusion plasma physics, fusion reaction candidates (e.g., D+3He, p+7Li, p+11B), and confinement approaches relevant to aneutronic concepts: magnetic confinement (mirrors, tokamaks, stellarators, spheromaks), inertial confinement, electrostatic/IEC devices (Fusor, Polywell), magneto-inertial schemes, dense plasma focus, and field-reversed configurations. The report notes aneutronic fuels avoid or greatly reduce neutron production (and associated shielding/material issues) but generally require higher ignition temperatures and more stringent confinement (implications for Lawson/Q). It reviews propulsion applications (fusion reactors for propulsion, air-breathing concepts, ion/plasma thrusters), asserts these concepts can outperform conventional electric thrusters for space use, and identifies near-term drivers (very large GEO satellites) and technology gaps: confinement, pulsed power, and ion-beam accelerators for >100 kW-class systems for missions to Mars and beyond. The document also surveys recent U.S., international, NASA, and privately funded R&D and presents a development roadmap with figures and tables.

This document is a Defense Intelligence Reference Document (DIRD), a technical reference format used by the Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) to capture baseline knowledge on a specific topic for later analytic use. DIRDs are best understood as reference and synthesis products rather than as original research. It is one of 38 DIRDs produced under the Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP) between 2009 and 2011. Because AAWSAP’s scope permitted a broad range of supporting topics, not every DIRD in the series directly concerns aerospace systems or future threat assessment. The following summary reflects the DIRD’s scope and framing at the time of writing and should not be read as implying current validation of the concepts discussed. This DIRD surveys ultracapacitors as high-power energy-storage devices and argues that their main value lies in extremely rapid charge and discharge, very long cycle life, and usefulness in systems that need short bursts of power rather than sustained energy delivery. The report explains how ultracapacitors differ from batteries, reviews the materials and cell designs that determine their performance, and emphasizes that they are especially useful for power stabilization, backup power, load leveling, regenerative braking, and other applications where fast energy transfer matters more than total stored energy. It also notes their drawbacks, including lower energy density, self-discharge, and voltage-management requirements that limit their usefulness as stand-alone replacements for batteries in many applications. The document presents ultracapacitors as a maturing and increasingly important technology whose most credible aerospace and military uses lie in pulsed-power, missile and munitions systems, electric propulsion support, and other hybrid power architectures rather than in long-duration primary energy storage.

本資料は、商用および軍用用途向けのウルトラキャパシタ（ウルトラキャップ、スーパーキャパシタ）に関する防衛情報参照文書の抜粋である。ウルトラキャップは電極と電解質の界面に形成される電気二重層に電荷を物理的に蓄える電気化学キャパシタで、極めて迅速な充放電（典型的に約1秒）と非常に長いサイクル寿命（>500,000回）を特徴とする。利点は高い出力密度と短時間でのパルス電力の供給・吸収能力であり、主な用途は電力変換器の電圧安定化、ピーク負荷補助、電子機器・電気通信・産業の負荷平準化、輸送、航空宇宙（例：雷管やミサイルの負荷平準化）などである。欠点としては比エネルギーが低い（資料中の代表値で約5 Wh/kg、リチウムイオン電池は100–200 Wh/kg）こと、自己放電率が高いこと、電圧制御のために電力変換器が必要なこと、そしてWh当たりコストが相対的に高い（資料の値で$10–20/Wh）点が挙げられる。歴史的には1966年にSOHIOが現在の形式の基礎を発明し、1978年にNECが商用化（SuperCapacitor™）した。技術的進展としては活性炭電極の多孔構造や電解質（水系は約1.2 Vに制限、より高電圧を得るため有機電解質へ移行）、疑似/ハイブリッドキャパシタ（片方電極を電池様材料に替える方式）によるエネルギー密度向上、カーボンナノチューブ・グラフェンなどの先進炭素材料、酸化物ベース薄膜、ならびにシリコンウェハ上で製造される磁気キャパシタ（MCap）などの最近の開発が報告されている。これら材料・プロセスの改良により、将来的にエネルギー密度の改善と大量生産への道が拓かれると記述されている。
This excerpt is from a Defense Intelligence Reference Document on ultracapacitors for commercial and military applications. Ultracapacitors (supercapacitors) store charge in the electrical double layer at the electrode/electrolyte interface, yielding very fast charge/discharge (~1 second) and very long cycle life (>500,000 cycles). Their strengths are high power density and the ability to absorb/deliver short bursts of energy, making them useful for voltage stabilization of power converters, peak-power support, electronics and telecommunications, industrial load leveling, transportation, and aerospace uses (e.g., munition fusing and missile power leveling). Limitations include low specific energy (document cites ~5 Wh/kg versus 100–200 Wh/kg for advanced lithium-ion cells), relatively high self-discharge, the need for power electronics to manage voltage, and higher cost per Wh (document cites $10–20/Wh) though lower cost per kW. Historical notes: SOHIO developed the common form in 1966 and NEC commercialized a SuperCapacitor™ in 1978. Recent developments covered include advanced carbon electrodes (activated carbon, CNTs, graphene), conductive polymers and metal oxides, oxide-based thin-film ultracaps, hybrid/pseudocapacitors (battery-like electrode paired with carbon), and emerging magnetic capacitors (MCap) manufactured with semiconductor processes. The document states that materials and thin-film/manufacturing improvements are driving increases in power and energy density and progress toward mass production.

DOW-UAP-D148, AAWSAP DIRD, Detection and High-Resolution Tracking of Vehicles at Hypersonic Velocities, November 2010
DOW-UAP-D148、AAWSAP DIRD、極超音速での車両の検出と高解像度追跡、2010 年 11 月
Department of War
米国戦争省
9/18/26
2026年9月18日（Release 06）
11/20/10
Las Vegas, Nevada
ネバダ州ラスベガス

This document is a Defense Intelligence Reference Document (DIRD), a technical reference format used by the Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) to capture baseline knowledge on a specific topic for later analytic use. DIRDs are best understood as reference and synthesis products rather than as original research. It is one of 38 DIRDs produced under the Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP) between 2009 and 2011. Because AAWSAP’s scope permitted a broad range of supporting topics, not every DIRD in the series directly concerns aerospace systems or future threat assessment. The following summary reflects the DIRD’s scope and framing at the time of writing and should not be read as implying current validation of the concepts discussed. This DIRD surveys how hypersonic vehicles may be detected and tracked by exploiting the physical effects they create in flight, especially shock waves, ionized gas, hot surfaces, and turbulent atmospheric wakes. The report reviews a broad set of detection methods, including radar, infrared sensing, optical imaging, LIDAR, passive radio reflection, infrasound, and seismic techniques, and argues that the most effective systems will likely combine multiple sensor types, because each captures different features of a high-speed vehicle’s passage through the atmosphere. It presents radar and infrared sensing as the strongest existing tools for operational detection, while giving particular attention to wake-based methods such as LIDAR and passive radio techniques for improving tracking, identification, and discrimination of future hypersonic aircraft. The paper identifies hypersonic vehicles as an evolving surveillance problem in which future progress will depend on better multi-sensor integration, improved wake characterization, and novel signature-exploitation techniques.
この文書は、国防情報参考文書 (DIRD) であり、国防情報局 (DIA) が特定のトピックに関するベースラインの知識を取得し、後で分析に使用するために使用する技術参照形式です。 DIRD は、独自の研究というよりも、参照製品および合成製品として最もよく理解されています。これは、2009 年から 2011 年にかけて先進航空宇宙兵器システム アプリケーション プログラム (AAWSAP) の下で作成された 38 の DIRD のうちの 1 つです。AAWSAP の範囲では幅広いサポート トピックが許可されていたため、シリーズのすべての DIRD が航空宇宙システムや将来の脅威の評価に直接関係しているわけではありません。以下の概要は、執筆時点での DIRD の範囲と枠組みを反映しており、議論されている概念の現在の検証を暗示するものとして読まないでください。この DIRD は、飛行中に極超音速飛行体が生み出す物理的影響、特に衝撃波、イオン化ガス、高温表面、乱流大気伴流を利用して極超音速飛行体をどのように検出し追跡できるかを調査します。この報告書では、レーダー、赤外線センシング、光学イメージング、LIDAR、受動的電波反射、超低周波音響、地震技術などの幅広い検出方法をレビューしており、最も効果的なシステムは複数のタイプのセンサーを組み合わせる可能性が高く、それぞれが高速車両の大気中通過の異なる特徴を捕捉するためであると主張しています。この論文では、運用検知のための既存の最強ツールとしてレーダーと赤外線センシングを紹介するとともに、将来の極超音速航空機の追跡、識別、識別を向上させるための LIDAR や受動無線技術などの航跡ベースの方法に特に注目しています。この論文では、極超音速機が進化する監視問題であると特定しており、将来の進歩は、より優れたマルチセンサー統合、航跡特性評価の改善、および新しい署名利用技術に依存しているとしている。

防諜目的の参照資料「超音速速度での車両の検出と高解像度追跡」は、国防情報局（DIA）防警戒部門（Technology Warning Division）作成（FY2010、著者：AAP Person 83）で、写真の再配布は許可されていない。本報告は、亜音速・超音速・超音速（hypersonic）流れの流体力学（境界層、後流、レイノルズ数・ストラウハル数、衝撃波とRankine–Hugoniot関係など）を概説し、流れ特性が検出技術に与える影響を論じる。対象となる超音速物体としては流星、軌道からの再突入体、ICBM再突入弾頭、有人・無人のロケットや航空機（例：X-15、SR-71、X-51等）が挙げられている。検出手法は大別して電磁（RADAR、ドップラー、無線反射等）、光学（空撮、赤外線、LIDAR等）、音響・地震（インフラサウンド、地震波）を比較し、衝撃波や高温プラズマ、後流の特徴を検出に利用する点を示す。文書は図表（衝撃波や赤外線スペクトル、LIDAR概略図等）や数値例（マッハ3の正常衝撃値）を含む。第4章では今後30年の展望として、既存機の後流データベース構築、超音速機の検出性を利用する方策、検出困難設計の探索、新規検出器の開発などの推奨を提示している。
The Defense Intelligence reference report "Detection and High Resolution Tracking of Vehicles at Hypersonic Velocities" (DIA Technology Warning Division, FY2010; author: AAP Person 83) provides an authoritative technical overview; reproduction of included photographs is restricted. The report reviews fluid mechanics across subsonic, supersonic and hypersonic regimes (boundary layers, wakes, Reynolds and Strouhal numbers, shock waves and Rankine–Hugoniot relations) and relates these flow phenomena to detection methods. Hypersonic object classes discussed include meteors, orbital reentry vehicles, ICBM reentry payloads, and manned/unmanned high-speed aircraft and rockets (examples cited). Detection approaches are categorized as electromagnetic (RADAR, Doppler, radio reflection), optical (sky cameras, infrared, LIDAR) and acoustic/seismic (infrasound, seismic), with emphasis on sensing bow shocks, ionized shock layers, heated wakes and reflected radiation. The document contains figures and tables (e.g., normal-shock values for Mach 3, IR spectra, LIDAR schematics) and concludes with a 30-year outlook including recommendations to build wake-characteristic databases, exploit detectability features of hypersonic vehicles, investigate detection of intentionally low-observable designs, and develop novel detectors.

Department of War

This document is a Defense Intelligence Reference Document (DIRD), a technical reference format used by the Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) to capture baseline knowledge on a specific topic for later analytic use. DIRDs are best understood as reference and synthesis products rather than as original research. It is one of 38 DIRDs produced under the Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP) between 2009 and 2011. Because AAWSAP’s scope permitted a broad range of supporting topics, not every DIRD in the series directly concerns aerospace systems or future threat assessment. The following summary reflects the DIRD’s scope and framing at the time of writing and should not be read as implying current validation of the concepts discussed. This DIRD surveys magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) and plasma-based concepts for air-breathing propulsion, onboard power generation, and aerodynamic control, arguing that such systems could in principle extend aerospace performance beyond the limits of conventional chemical propulsion and control surfaces. The report reviews concepts including MHD acceleration, flow control, inlet control, onboard power generation, drag reduction, and plasma-generated “virtual” aerodynamic surfaces, while giving particular attention to hypersonic applications such as scramjet power extraction, reentry vehicles, global-strike gliders, and aero-assisted orbital maneuvers. However, it emphasizes major practical constraints, especially extreme power requirements, system weight and complexity, and the difficulty of achieving useful ionization in colder air at lower hypersonic speeds; on that basis, it argues that Ajax-style MHD bypass concepts, in which energy is extracted from the airflow upstream and reintroduced downstream through an electromagnetic system, are not meaningful below about Mach 12, while treating the “virtual cowl” and related reentry applications as more plausible. The document presents plasma and MHD aerospace systems as a technically serious but highly demanding field whose nearer-term promise lies in specialized hypersonic control, power generation, and reentry applications rather than a fully realized air-breathing propulsion system.

本報告は、プラズマ（弱くイオン化した気体）と磁気流体力学（MHD）を用いた航空宇宙用推進・発電の概観を示す。プラズマ／MHDは従来技術を大きく超える推進・空力性能や、可動部のない高出力発生（例：スクラム燃焼直後や再突入の表面統合型MHD発電）を可能にする一方、重量・複雑性・高電力需要や、Mach<12の“冷たい”空気では大量のエネルギーを要する人工イオン化が大きな障害となると指摘する。よく知られたAjaxのMHDエネルギーバイパスは少なくともMach 12未満では実効性がなく、新たな「リバースエネルギーバイパス」とVirtual Cowlは吸気式ハイパーソニック機へ現実的な応用可能性があるとされる。再突入体、全球打撃用ハイパーソニックグライダー、気動支援軌道機動などの短中期応用が有望であり、機上で強力な電源（原子炉等）を搭載すればMHD応用の展望は大きく広がる。プラズマの利点としては遠隔加熱、可変な仮想表面形成、点火促進、電磁・電気流体力学（MHD/EHD）による流れ制御が挙げられるが、非平衡イオン化の効率とイオナイザの電力負担が運用上の鍵である。短期的に実用性が高い技術としては低消費電力で剥離制御に有効な非対称ダイレクト・バリア放電（DBD）プラズマアクチュエータや、プラズマ支援燃焼技術が挙げられる。宇宙用途では化学ロケットから電気（プラズマ）推進への移行が進行中であり、電気推進は比推力が高い一方で搭載電源質量により推力が制約される（“出力制限型”）。電気推進は電熱・静電（グリッド）・電磁（ExB）に大別され、電源（太陽／原子炉等）とパワー処理装置が重要な構成要素である。
This Defense Intelligence reference reviews plasma (weakly ionized gas) and magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) concepts for propulsion and onboard power in aerospace applications. Plasma/MHD can enable propulsion and aerodynamic performance beyond conventional technologies and permit high-power generation without moving parts (e.g., MHD generators downstream of scramjets or surface-integrated MHD on reentry vehicles), but development is hindered by weight, complexity, high power requirements, and the large energy cost of artificial ionization in “cold” air at Mach <12. The well-known Ajax MHD energy-bypass is judged ineffective below roughly Mach 12; by contrast a newly described “reverse energy bypass” with a Virtual Cowl may be practical for air‑breathing hypersonic vehicles. Near‑term promising applications include reentry, global‑strike hypersonic gliders, and aeroassisted orbital maneuvering; onboard nuclear power (fission/fusion) would substantially expand MHD applicability. The report highlights plasma capabilities—volume/remote heating, deployable virtual surfaces, plasma‑assisted ignition, and MHD/EHD flow control—and notes that achievable MHD effects depend critically on ionization efficiency, magnetic field strength, or localized/transient application. Practical near‑term technologies include dielectric barrier discharge (DBD) plasma actuators for flow/sep‑aration control and various plasma‑assisted combustion methods. For space, the transition from chemical rockets to electric (plasma) propulsion is expected to continue: electric systems offer much higher specific impulse but are power‑limited (thrust constrained by onboard power mass). Electric thrusters are categorized as electrothermal, electrostatic, and electromagnetic, and require power sources (solar, nuclear, beamed) plus power processing units.

DIRDs are best understood as reference and synthesis products rather than as original research. It is one of 38 DIRDs produced under the Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP) between 2009 and 2011. Because AAWSAP’s scope permitted a broad range of supporting topics, not every DIRD in the series directly concerns aerospace systems or future threat assessment. The following summary reflects the DIRD’s scope and framing at the time of writing and should not be read as implying current validation of the concepts discussed. This DIRD surveys advanced computing concepts for future space and automation applications, focusing on quantum and molecular (DNA-based) computing as potential alternatives to conventional silicon electronics. The report introduces quantum computing principles alongside DNA-based logic gates, self-assembly, and nanoscale repair mechanisms, arguing that these unconventional architectures might eventually offer advantages in radiation tolerance, physical robustness, and specialized onboard processing for space-based platforms. It notes that near-term practical barriers remain substantial. Quantum systems continue to depend on complex cryogenics, shielding, and unsolved reliability challenges, while DNA-based computing remains a far-future concept rather than a viable alternative to general-purpose processors. Overall, the document presents both frameworks as long-term possibilities to complement, rather than immediately replace proven space-qualified electronics. It concludes that the stronger, nearer-term cases for such architectures are in highly specialized or hybrid roles rather than in fully mature general-purpose onboard computing applications.

本報告書（Defense Intelligence Reference Document、2010年12月）は、航空宇宙用途のオンボード高性能演算に関する代替技術としての量子コンピューティングと有機分子（主にDNA）ベースの分子コンピューティングを概説する非評価的な参照資料である。序論と目次は、量子計算の基礎、グラフェン量子ドット（静電量子ドット、ナノリボン、単層・二層グラフェンディスク）、スピン量子ビットの緩和・デコヒーレンス、光子・イオン・原子トラップ・NMR・超伝導技術などの無機アプローチをまとめることを示す。DNAに関しては、基礎、合成、タイル自己組織化と誤り抑制、マイクロ流体デバイス、DNAオリガミ、デオキシリボザイムによる論理ゲート、DNAナノマシン（ロボット、ナノモータ、ナノウォーカー）を扱う。要旨の主要結論は以下の通り：オンボードスーパーコンピューティングは長期宇宙探査で必要となる可能性が高く、既存のシリコン商用ハードウェアは放射線耐性や小型化の面で限界がある。短中期の展望として、イオントラップに基づく実用的な量子コンピュータは研究資源の集中から10年以内に登場しうるが、イオン・原子トラップは低温・電磁遮蔽を要し宇宙搭載には不向きとされる。光子技術はミニチュア化とスケーラビリティに課題があるが活発な研究により10年～20年で進展が見込まれ、40年視野では分散量子計算で重要な役割を果たすと予測される。グラフェン量子ドットと光子通信のハイブリッドやスピントロニクスは、極低温を必要とせず宇宙向けスーパーコンピューティングの潜在的選択肢となり得る。DNAタイル基盤の単純な有機計算は20年程度、実用的なDNAデバイスや自己修復可能なDNAコンピュータは40年程度のタイムラインで期待され、放射線損傷を自己修復できる点で堅牢性の利点が強調される。
This Defense Intelligence Reference Document (10 Dec 2010) is a non-evaluative authoritative review of alternative computing technologies for automation and aerospace applications, focusing on quantum computing and organic/molecular (primarily DNA) computing. The report outlines quantum computing fundamentals and state-of-the-art approaches—including graphene-based quantum dots (electrostatic dots, nanoribbons, single- and bilayer graphene discs), spin qubits and decoherence—and summarizes other inorganic technologies (photonics, ion/atomic traps, NMR, superconducting). For DNA it covers background and synthesis, tile-based self-assembly and error suppression, microfluidic fabrication, DNA origami, deoxyribozyme logic gates, and DNA nanomachines (robots, nanomotors, walkers). Key conclusions: onboard supercomputing will be desirable for long-duration space missions but commercial silicon trajectories face radiation-hardness and miniaturization limits. Forecasts in the report state that ion-trap–based quantum computers capable of solving real-world problems could appear within ~10 years, though ion/atomic traps require cryogenics and EM shielding making them impractical for space. Photonic technologies face miniaturization and scalability challenges but may see disruptive advances in 10–20 years and play a role in distributed quantum computing by ~40 years. Hybrid designs combining quantum dots and photonic channels, and spintronics, are identified as potential ~40-year options for space-capable supercomputing that do not require extreme cryogenics. DNA tile computing is projected within ~20 years, with useful DNA-based devices and self-repairing DNA computers feasible on a ~40-year timescale; self-repair is highlighted as a robustness advantage despite not yielding the fastest systems.

DOW-UAP-D151, AAWSAP DIRD, Cognitive Limits on Simultaneous Control of Multiple Unmanned Spacecraft, December 2010
DOW-UAP-D151、AAWSAP DIRD、複数の無人宇宙船の同時制御に関する認知限界、2010 年 12 月
Department of War
米国戦争省
9/18/26
2026年9月18日（Release 06）
12/15/10
Las Vegas, Nevada
ネバダ州ラスベガス
PDF
PDF
This document is a Defense Intelligence Reference Document (DIRD), a technical reference format used by the Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) to capture baseline knowledge on a specific topic for later analytic use. DIRDs are best understood as reference and synthesis products rather than as original research. It is one of 38 DIRDs produced under the Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP) between 2009 and 2011. Because AAWSAP’s scope permitted a broad range of supporting topics, not every DIRD in the series directly concerns aerospace systems or future threat assessment. The following summary reflects the DIRD’s scope and framing at the time of writing and should not be read as implying current validation of the concepts discussed. This DIRD examines how many unmanned spacecraft a single human operator could realistically supervise or control at once, using research from air traffic control and multi-vehicle remote piloting as rough analogs. The report argues that the practical limit depends heavily on task complexity: about 16 craft for simple monitoring or destination assignment, about 7 for moderately complex piloting or mission tasks, and about 4 for complex heterogeneous operations. It places particular emphasis on the operator’s ability to maintain a coherent mental “big picture” of multiple vehicles at once, and it suggests that automation and external displays can help by offloading working-memory demands, though not eliminating them. The document also highlights physiological workload measures as a possible way to detect or predict operator overload in real time. Overall, it presents multi-spacecraft control as a human-factors and systems-integration problem in which progress depends on managing cognitive limits through interface design, automation, and workload monitoring.

本資料は、将来の有人深宇宙ミッションで想定される無人支援艦隊を例に、人間操縦者が同時に複数の無人宇宙船を監視・操縦する際の認知的限界を検討した防衛情報局のリファレンス文書である。直接の宇宙船遠隔操縦に関する査読論文はほとんどなく、既存研究は主に航空管制（ATC）と複数無人車両の遠隔操縦の分野に依拠している。操縦者は各機体の識別・位置・任務・進行方向を含む「ビッグピクチャー（状況認識）」を内部表象として維持するが、維持可能な対象数は任務の複雑さに依存する。既存の研究モデルでは、同時制御可能な機体数の認知的限界は単純な目的地選択で約16、適度に複雑な操縦・任務で約7、複雑で異種混合の機体では約4とされる。また、作業負荷とパフォーマンスの関係（最適領域－劣化領域－過負荷領域）を示し、主観評価（NASA-TLX、SWAT、観察による利用率）、パフォーマンス指標（反応時間・正確性・二重課題）、生理学的指標（心拍・HRV、EEG/NIRS/ERP、眼の注視・瞳孔変化、皮膚伝導、ホルモン）を用いた測定法を概説する。生理学的変数を用いて高負荷状態や過負荷を分類・予測することには一定の成功があるが、現時点で外部補助を含めても一度に完全なメンタルイメージを維持できる対象数が16を大きく超える裏付けはないとされる。
This Defense Intelligence Reference Document examines cognitive limits on a human operator’s simultaneous control of multiple unmanned spacecraft, motivated by prospective deep-space missions employing unmanned support fleets. Direct peer‑reviewed research on remote piloting of multiple spacecraft is scarce; the review therefore relies on extensive literature from air traffic control (ATC) and emerging studies of multiple unmanned vehicle teleoperation. Operators maintain a mental representation (“big picture”/situational awareness) of each asset’s identity, position, mission, and heading; the number of objects maintainable depends on task complexity. Existing models and studies indicate approximate cognitive limits of ~16 objects for simple destination selection tasks, ~7 for moderately complex piloting/mission tasks, and ~4 for complex heterogeneous vehicles. The report describes the workload–performance relationship (optimal, degradation, overload regions) and summarizes measurement methods: subjective (NASA‑TLX, SWAT, expert observation, utilization), performance (reaction time, accuracy, secondary‑task paradigms), and physiological measures (cardiac: EKG/HRV; CNS: EEG/NIRS/ERP; ocular: fixations/pupil; skin conductance; hormone assays). Physiological indicators have shown nominal success in classifying high‑workload/overload states, but there is no current evidence supporting maintenance of a complete mental picture for substantially more than ~16 objects even with external memory aids.

This document is a Defense Intelligence Reference Document (DIRD), a technical reference format used by the Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) to capture baseline knowledge on a specific topic for later analytic use. DIRDs are best understood as reference and synthesis products rather than as original research. It is one of 38 DIRDs produced under the Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP) between 2009 and 2011. Because AAWSAP’s scope permitted a broad range of supporting topics, not every DIRD in the series directly concerns aerospace systems or future threat assessment. The following summary reflects the DIRD’s scope and framing at the time of writing and should not be read as implying current validation of the concepts discussed. This DIRD examines whether negative mass could exist in a physically meaningful way and whether it could someday reduce the energy cost of spaceflight. The report reviews the unusual dynamics that would follow if positive and negative mass could interact, including self-accelerating mass pairs and matter with very low or nearly zero effective inertia, and treats such ideas as at least formally compatible with certain extensions of gravitational theory. It then considers two broad paths toward practical use: creating or separating negative mass through extreme fields or particle energies, and locating naturally separated negative matter in deep gravitational wells such as galactic centers or possibly the Moon. However, the document also concludes that the first path is effectively beyond technical reach and treats the second as highly uncertain, resting on a long chain of unverified assumptions about the existence, separability, and macroscopic behavior of negative mass. Overall, this DIRD is a far-reaching theoretical exploration of an exotic propulsion concept whose practical application depends on premises that remain unestablished in consensus physics.

文書名「Negative Mass Propulsion」は米国防情報局（DIA）防衛警告局技術警告部門（DW0-4）作成の参照文書（発行日03 Jan 2011、ICOD 30 Aug 2010）で、負の質量の理論的取り扱いと推進利用の可能性を概説している。主な主張は、負の質量は正の質量により“幽閉”されて我々の周囲に存在し得るが、それらを推進に利用するには正の質量から解放する技術的手段が必要であるという点である。解放の方法として①極めて強い電磁場・重力場や高エネルギー粒子の適用（技術的に現実的でない可能性が高い）と②自然が既に分離した場所（重力ポテンシャル井戸）での採掘の二案が示される。後者の候補としては、月の中心は到達可能な深さのポテンシャル井戸であり、十分な負の質量があれば月にトンネルを掘って採掘することで恒星間航行を変革し得ると述べる（トンネル掘削には熱核シェイプチャージの逐次使用が想定される）。理論的背景としてBondiの負質量双極子モデルの扱い、Hundの非線形ニュートン重力の解析、負質量・質量双極子が自己加速する性質、及びディラック方程式に関連するジッターバーグ現象を負質量成分の現れと見る議論が含まれる。特殊相対性理論の解釈（ミンコフスキー的運動学的解釈とローレンツ・ポアンカレの動的エーテル解釈）の違いやプランクエーテル仮説にも言及している。
The document "Negative Mass Propulsion" is a Defense Intelligence Reference Document prepared by the DIA Technology Warning Division (DW0-4) (issued 03 Jan 2011, ICOD 30 Aug 2010). It reviews theoretical treatments of negative mass and assesses their potential for propulsion. The central position is that negative masses could exist hidden by positive masses, but using them for propulsion requires freeing them from positive-mass confinement. Two approaches are identified: (1) application of extremely strong electromagnetic or gravitational fields or very high particle energies (deemed practically unattainable), and (2) locating astrophysical sites where nature has already separated negative masses (gravity potential wells) and mining them. The moon's center is highlighted as an accessible potential well; tunneling through the Moon (envisioned using sequential thermonuclear shape charges) could allow extraction of negative mass and potentially revolutionize interstellar travel if sufficient negative mass is available. The report also discusses theoretical foundations: Bondi's treatment of negative-mass dipoles, Hund's nonlinear Newtonian gravity, the self-accelerating behavior of positive/negative mass dipoles, and the interpretation of zitterbewegung and Dirac negative-energy components as manifestations of negative-mass contributions. It further touches on differing interpretations of special relativity and a Planck-aether hypothesis.

This document is a Defense Intelligence Reference Document (DIRD), a technical reference format used by the Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) to capture baseline knowledge on a specific topic for later analytic use. DIRDs are best understood as reference and synthesis products rather than as original research. It is one of 38 DIRDs produced under the Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP) between 2009 and 2011. Because AAWSAP’s scope permitted a broad range of supporting topics, not every DIRD in the series directly concerns aerospace systems or future threat assessment. The following summary reflects the DIRD’s scope and framing at the time of writing and should not be read as implying current validation of the concepts discussed. This DIRD examines how negative-energy, or “sub-vacuum,” states in quantum fields might be detected and mapped. Its practical scope is limited to the laboratory-scale measurement of minute quantum effects, though it extrapolates from those effects to consider theoretical relevance to concepts such as warp drives, wormholes, or gravitational control. By reviewing previously identified laboratory examples such as the Casimir effect and squeezed light states, the report identifies the core technical challenge as mapping their spatial and temporal structures reliably. To address this, it proposes quantum optical homodyne tomography as a method to reconstruct and quantify the vacuum fluctuations associated with these states. The document acknowledges that only microscopic, transient negative-energy effects have been realized in laboratory settings. It remains unknown whether larger or longer-lived distributions of such effects can be generated or stabilized, particularly given the experimentally unresolved constraints imposed by quantum inequalities. Overall, this DIRD functions as a measurement- and diagnostics-oriented review intended to lay experimental groundwork for a far more ambitious, highly speculative negative-energy research agenda.

本報告書「Quantum Tomography of Negative Energy States in the Vacuum」（DIA、2011年1月）は、真空中の負（サブ真空）エネルギー状態を実験的に検出・空間的にマッピングするための量子光学的手法の概説と提案をまとめた参照文書である。動機は、ワームホールやワープドライブ等の理論的推進概念で必要とされる“異種”物質（負エネルギー）を実際に測定・制御できるかを評価することである。報告は量子場理論における負エネルギーの存在と典型例（絞られた真空状態とカシミール効果）を概説し、従来のエネルギー条件が量子効果で破られること、負エネルギーが実験室で生成されていることを述べる。量子光学の基礎（モード、消滅・生成演算子、四分位 q,p、真空零点ゆらぎ）を説明した上で、量子光学ホモダイントモグラフィ（Wigner関数、ビームスプリッタ、フォトダイオード、バランスドホモダイン検出器）を用いて電場の一次・二次相関や真空ゆらぎを定量化する手法を提示する。特に、Hansenらによる絞られた真空の時間領域負エネルギーパルス解析や、Mareckiによるカシミールキャビティ内部基底状態の二点関数・スペクトル密度計算に基づき、BHDを用いた位置・周波数依存の応答測定と負エネルギーの空間マッピングの可能性が示される。報告書は実験手順、各種図（ウィグナー関数、BHD構成、カシミール配置等）、および時間領域／キャビティ用のBHDシステム設計案を含む。
The report "Quantum Tomography of Negative Energy States in the Vacuum" (DIA, 11 Jan 2011) is a reference document that surveys and proposes quantum-optical methods to detect and spatially map negative (sub-vacuum) energy in laboratory settings. Motivated by theoretical propulsion concepts that require exotic (negative-energy) matter, the document reviews the inevitability of negative energy states in quantum field theory and highlights two laboratory-relevant examples: squeezed vacuum states and the Casimir effect. It explains how classical energy conditions can be violated by quantum effects, outlines basic quantum-optical formalism (modes, annihilation/creation operators, quadratures q and p, vacuum zero-point fluctuations), and presents quantum optical homodyne tomography as a tool to quantify vacuum fluctuations via one- and two-point functions. Building on prior analyses (Hansen et al. for time-domain squeezed-state pulses; Marecki for Casimir-cavity ground-state two-point functions and spectral density), the report describes how balanced homodyne detectors (BHDs) can produce position- and frequency-dependent responses suitable for mapping negative energy. The document includes experimental outlines, theory (Wigner functions, beam splitters, photodiodes), figures, and proposed time-domain and Casimir-cavity BHD system configurations.

The United States Central Command submitted a report of an unidentified anomalous phenomenon to the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO) consisting of a still image derived from an infrared system aboard a U.S. military system in 2022. An accompanying mission report, DOW-UAP-D106, described the UAP as “flying sporadically… at various speeds between 80-180 miles per hour.” Image Description: This image features two areas of contrast. One appears near the center of the sensor display, bounded by a reticle. Another appears in the lower third of the frame. The area of contrast in the lower third of the frame appears elongated and is followed by a visible trail. These features suggest motion across the focal plane from the top right to the bottom left of the sensor field-of-view. The apparent trail is consistent with known image-compression and processing effects and does not necessarily represent a physical feature. This image description is provided for informational purposes only. Readers should not interpret any part of this description as reflecting an analytical judgment, investigative conclusion, or factual determination regarding the described event’s validity, nature, or significance.

地元の法執行官は、2023 年 10 月に、市販の携帯端末の背面カメラからの 27 秒間のビデオ映像からなる未確認の異常現象の報告書を全領域異常解決室に提出しました。報告官は、この現象は「静か」で、「赤、青、緑の点滅ライト」を特徴としていると説明しました。動画の説明: この動画の最初の 2 秒で、AARO はこの映像の下半分をぼかし、その公開が米国人または営利団体のプライバシーまたはその他の保護された利益に影響を与えることが合理的に予想される情報を不明瞭にすることで、この映像をデジタル的に変更しました。 00:00-00:27: カメラは倍率のレベルを上げ、ビデオの持続時間中見かけの光源に焦点を合わせ、光源をほぼ中央に保ち、フレームの上 3 分の 1 以内に保ちます。 AARO コメント: この映像の撮影に使用されたタイプの携帯端末は、オートフォーカスやその他の自動画像処理機能を使用しているため、特に高倍率の場合、遠くの被写体の見かけの形態学的および運動学的特徴が歪む可能性があります。
